_why: Radial location of the rigid retainer on the solid post: the ID4.7 band over the D4.4 post near the head (plus rim ID5.0 over the post root). Plain running fit - the bayonet does the retention, this only centers the journal sleeve. At worst case the band just touches (0.0 clearance, floor set to -0.02 for float-arithmetic honesty): still assembles - straight cylinders, no wedge, and the fit only centers the sleeve.
